limitations.ENTITY: Whale transactions and UTXO candidates do not establish entity ownership or verified exchange netflows.
limitations.GLOBAL_LIQUIDATIONS: Sampled venue notices and short listening windows do not establish whole-market or full-day liquidation totals.
limitations.ETF_VINTAGES: Trade date is not availability. No pre-first-seen training or complete historical publication-vintage claim.
limitations.MACRO_CAUSAL: Observation dates and scheduled calendars do not establish release-time surprises or causal DOGE effects.
limitations.TRAINED_WEIGHTS: Five pillars are evidence inventory only. No new fitted coefficients, 70% accuracy, or trading edge authorized.
limitations.LOCAL_RETENTION: Local exclusive writes, hashes and predecessor links detect some mutations and missing predecessors. Deletion of the newest suffix or whole archive cannot be proven locally; independent retention lock is not established.

supporting_scope: Byte-exact operational registry/score/protocol/publication/quote/execution archives only; no semantic source timestamps inferred
